name: Sharf
definition: Uses a generative model of voxelized shapes of objects in a category, which in turn condition a higher resolution neural radiance field that is rendered using volume rendering for higher novel view synthesis fidelity.
summary: Sharf generates diverse 3D shapes and high-fidelity views by combining a generative voxel grid model with a conditional neural radiance field, explicitly discretizing shape generation unlike continuous latent methods.
